headline: As of 2026-11-03: 64,618,284 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+7.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 64,618,284 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+7.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Florida (8,241,284), Texas (8,098,834), California (7,202,817).
